entries.source: Informace o malformacích zjištěných prenatálně. Hodnoty: No / Unique / Multiple.
entries.target:
Indicate if any structural or functional foetal anomaly was detected during antenatal imaging or screening (amniotic fluid anomaly, umbilical cord anomaly, foetal anomaly, etc.).

This data element is Not Mandatory and is only to be completed if relevant.

The recommended data standard is Value Set: No / Unique / Multiple

•	No: no anomalies were detected during antenatal screening.
•	Single: a single abnormality was detected during antenatal screening.
•	Multiple: several abnormalities were detected during antenatal screening.
